# hiiro

**Tag**: cli, tooling, devops

## 简介

Build multi-command CLI tools with subcommand dispatch, abbreviation matching, and a plugin system. Similar to git or docker command structure.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/unixsuperhero/hiiro
- 更新日志: https://github.com/unixsuperhero/hiiro/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/hiiro
